scripts.title: Free Kill Aura script
scripts.script:
_G.test = true
local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

task.spawn(function()
    while _G.test do
        task.wait(0.1)
        

        pcall(function()

            sethiddenproperty(LP, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
            

            local entities = workspace.World:FindFirstChild("Entities")
            if entities then
                for _, v in pairs(entities:GetChildren()) do
          
                    if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name ~= LP.Name then
                        local hum = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local hrp = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        
                        if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                           
                            hum.Health = 0
                            
                           
                            if hrp then
                                hrp.CanCollide = false
                                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, -500, hrp.Position.Z)
                            end
                            
                            print("Targeted: " .. v.Name)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)
